title: Opening a filter tab directly starts at the top-left
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
custom_steps:
1. Open a filter tab directly by its link/URL (e.g. Completed).
  2. Observe the starting scroll position of the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Opening a filter tab directly by its link starts you at the top-left of the page.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10044 — Switch between display options. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S1-R12 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R12: “In Tech View and Board View, opening a filter view any way other than browser Back (for example clicking its tab, a link, or a menu item) starts scrolled to the top and all the way to the left. List behaves as it does today.”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on the Work Orders QA build
